datasets.name: Sentinel-2 L2A images
datasets.verbatim: In Taitung, Jiuzhaigou and Haiti, Sentinel-2 L2A images were acquired from Google Earth Engine, with a resolution of 10 m per pixel.

datasets.name: TripleSat imagery of Bijie
datasets.verbatim: The satellite imagery of Bijie was acquired from TripleSat (Ji et al. 2020), with a spatial resolution of 0.8 m per pixel

datasets.name: Hokkaido Iburi-Tobu imagery
datasets.verbatim: Hokkaido Iburi-Tobu was sourced from the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan, with a spatial resolution of 3 m per pixel.

datasets.name: Landslide ground truth data for Hokkaido and Haiti
datasets.verbatim: The landslide ground truth data for these areas were downloaded from GitHub (Xu et al. 2024)...The data used in this study is available at https://github.com/Bynus5/Landslide-dataset

methods.name: LSL-SS-Net (level set loss-guided semantic segmentation network)
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation framework that integrates a novel level set loss (LSL) function. The LSL function uses a fast region-scalable fitting energy function, Laplacian of Gaussian energy, and a tanh-based Heaviside approximation to guide the network in optimizing spatial details and boundary delineation during training.
methods.verbatim: This study presents a level set loss-guided semantic segmentation network...the code in this study is available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide ground truth data is linked and accessible, and other input datasets are practically accessible via public providers. The custom code for the LSL-SS-Net method is not provided via a repository or persistent link.
